slots.name: AOC poll support
slots.sentence: She received 12% support from Democrats in a Harvard-Harris poll taken in late September, ranking just ahead of former Transportation Secretary Pete Buttigieg, who had 11% support, and behind California Gov. Gavin Newsom, who received 17%.
